name: Kirkland Signature Hand-Pulled Rotisserie Chicken Breast Meat (Vacuum Pack)
whyItWorks: Sold in the refrigerated deli cases, these bags contain 100% white breast meat stripped clean of fatty skin, wing fat, cartilage, and bones. It provides ultra-convenient, pure lean protein with zero roughage, ideal for active flare recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat cold right out of the bag, shred into warm white rice, or gently warm in chicken bone broth. Discard any stray bits of dark skin if found.
